scenario: A retail bank loan officer uses three skills to pre-qualify a personal loan applicant: first assessing FICO creditworthiness and tier classification, then computing the debt-to-income ratio and monthly payment affordability, and finally packaging a structured loan origination recommendation.
info_flow: credit-repair-skill classifies the applicant's FICO score into a risk tier and produces a creditworthiness summary → financial-calculator computes the monthly payment, annualized cost, and debt-to-income ratio → loan packages the tier classification and DTI figure into a final origination recommendation including term structure and approval disposition.
